name: photo-relic-editorial
title_zh: 把照片做成有东方留白的记忆文物海报
tagline_zh: 照片还是那张照片，但旁边长出一块「记忆化石」——像版画、像残片、像光本身。适合不想只套滤镜、想要画廊质感的你。
tagline_en: Keep the real photo, add a relic that looks like memory itself — printmaking, quiet restraint, light from the.
desc_en: Create distinctive Photo Relic editorial artworks from user-provided photographs: preserve the real photo and pair it with a recognizable, artful abstract relic shaped like memory, modern printmaking, quiet Eastern restraint, and source-derived light. why_zh: 它不覆盖原图，而是从照片里提取光源，生成一块可辨识的抽象残片与照片并置。东方留白不是装饰，是构图机制。
why_en: It never overwrites the original — it distills light from the photo into an abstract relic placed beside it. The Eastern.
limit_zh: 只吃单张人像或静物照片，且主体需占画面 30% 以上；输出为单张竖版海报（3:4），不做组图、不做横版、不修脸。
limit_en: Single portrait or still-life only, subject >30% of frame. Output: one 3:4 poster. No series, no landscape, no face retouch, no background swap.
